cards.example: The **HPA** automatically scales the number of Pod replicas.

cards.back: 垂直Pod自动伸缩器 - 自动调整Pod资源请求
cards.example: The **VPA** automatically adjusts CPU and memory for Pods.

cards.back: 集群自动伸缩器 - 自动调整节点数量
cards.example: The **Cluster Autoscaler** adjusts the number of nodes in a cluster.

cards.back: 命名空间 - Kubernetes中的资源隔离
cards.example: A **namespace** isolates resources within a Kubernetes cluster.

cards.back: 标签 - Kubernetes中附加到资源的键值对
cards.example: **Labels** are key-value pairs attached to Kubernetes resources for selection.

cards.back: 选择器 - Kubernetes中根据标签选择资源
cards.example: A **selector** matches resources based on their labels in Kubernetes.

cards.back: 注解 - Kubernetes中附加到资源的非标识元数据
cards.example: **Annotations** store non-identifying metadata on Kubernetes resources.

cards.back: 持久卷 - Kubernetes中的网络存储资源
cards.example: A **Persistent Volume** is a piece of storage in a Kubernetes cluster.

cards.back: 持久卷声明 - 对存储资源的请求
cards.example: A **PVC** is a request for storage by a Pod.

cards.back: 存储类 - 定义存储类型的资源
cards.example: A **StorageClass** defines different classes of storage in Kubernetes.

cards.back: Helm - Kubernetes的包管理器
cards.example: **Helm** is a package manager for Kubernetes applications.

cards.back: Helm图表 - Helm打包的应用
cards.example: A Helm **chart** is a collection of files that describe a Kubernetes application.

cards.back: Helm仓库 - 存储和共享Helm图表的地方
cards.example: A **Helm repository** stores and shares Helm charts.

cards.back: Kustomize - Kubernetes配置定制工具
cards.example: **Kustomize** customizes Kubernetes configurations without templates.

cards.back: 服务网格 - 管理服务间通信的基础设施层
cards.example: A **service mesh** manages service-to-service communication.

cards.back: Istio - 开源服务网格平台
cards.example: **Istio** provides traffic management, security, and observability for microservices.

cards.back: Linkerd - 轻量级服务网格
cards.example: **Linkerd** is a lightweight, ultra-fast service mesh for Kubernetes.

cards.back: Envoy - 高性能边缘和服务代理
cards.example: **Envoy** is a high-performance C++ distributed proxy designed for single services.

cards.back: 边车容器 - 与主容器协同运行的容器
cards.example: A **sidecar container** extends the functionality of the main application container.

cards.back: 初始化容器 - 在主容器启动前运行的容器
cards.example: An **init container** runs before the main container to perform setup tasks.

cards.back: 就绪探针 - 检查容器是否准备好接收流量
cards.example: A **readiness probe** checks if a container is ready to receive traffic.

cards.back: 存活探针 - 检查容器是否仍在运行
cards.example: A **liveness probe** checks if a container is still running properly.

cards.back: 启动探针 - 检查容器是否已启动
cards.example: A **startup probe** checks if a container has started successfully.

cards.back: 资源配额 - 限制命名空间资源使用
cards.example: A **ResourceQuota** limits resource consumption per namespace.

cards.back: 限制范围 - 限制容器资源使用
cards.example: A **LimitRange** enforces minimum and maximum resource constraints.

cards.back: 网络策略 - 控制Pod间网络流量
cards.example: A **NetworkPolicy** controls traffic flow between Pods.

cards.back: 基于角色的访问控制 - Kubernetes权限管理
cards.example: **RBAC** regulates access to resources based on user roles.

cards.back: 服务账户 - Pod使用的身份
cards.example: A **service account** provides an identity for a Pod to access the API.

cards.back: 角色 - 定义权限的规则集
cards.example: A **Role** defines permissions within a namespace.

cards.back: 集群角色 - 集群范围的权限
cards.example: A **ClusterRole** defines permissions across the entire cluster.

cards.back: 角色绑定 - 将角色授予用户
cards.example: A **RoleBinding** grants a Role to a user or service account.

cards.back: 集群角色绑定 - 集群范围的角色绑定
cards.example: A **ClusterRoleBinding** grants a ClusterRole across the cluster.

cards.back: Pod安全策略 - 控制Pod安全上下文
cards.example: A **Pod Security Policy** controls security-sensitive aspects of Pods.

cards.back: Pod安全标准 - 内置的Pod安全级别
cards.example: **Pod Security Standards** define three security levels: privileged, baseline, restricted.

cards.back: 开放策略代理 - 通用策略引擎
cards.example: **OPA** (Open Policy Agent) provides policy-based control.

cards.back: Gatekeeper - Kubernetes的OPA准入控制器
cards.example: **Gatekeeper** enforces OPA policies in Kubernetes via admission control.

cards.back: 准入控制器 - 拦截Kubernetes API请求的组件
cards.example: An **admission controller** intercepts requests to the Kubernetes API.

cards.back: 变更准入 - 修改资源的准入控制器
cards.example: A **mutating admission** controller can modify requests before persistence.

cards.back: 验证准入 - 验证资源的准入控制器
cards.example: A **validating admission** controller validates requests without modifying them.

cards.back: 自定义资源定义 - 扩展Kubernetes API
cards.example: A **CRD** extends the Kubernetes API with custom resource types.

cards.back: Operator - 自动化运维复杂应用的Kubernetes模式
cards.example: An **Operator** automates operation of complex applications on Kubernetes.

cards.back: Operator SDK - 构建Operator的工具
cards.example: The **Operator SDK** provides tools to build, test, and package Operators.

cards.back: 控制器 - 监控资源状态并做出调整的控制循环
cards.example: A **controller** watches the shared state and makes changes to achieve desired state.

cards.back: 控制平面 - Kubernetes的管理组件
cards.example: The **control plane** manages the cluster's worker nodes and Pods.

cards.back: kubelet - 节点上的Pod管理代理
cards.example: The **kubelet** is an agent that runs on each node in the cluster.

cards.back: kube-proxy - 节点上的网络代理
cards.example: **kube-proxy** maintains network rules on nodes for Pod communication.

cards.back: etcd - 分布式键值存储
cards.example: **etcd** is a distributed key-value store for Kubernetes cluster data.

cards.back: API服务器 - Kubernetes的中央管理组件
cards.example: The **API server** is the front end of the Kubernetes control plane.

cards.back: 调度器 - 分配Pod到节点的组件
cards.example: The **scheduler** assigns Pods to available nodes based on resources.

cards.back: 控制器管理器 - 运行控制器的组件
cards.example: The **controller manager** runs controller processes in Kubernetes.

cards.back: 云控制器管理器 - 云提供商接口
cards.example: The **cloud controller manager** integrates with underlying cloud provider APIs.

cards.back: 节点 - Kubernetes集群中的工作机器
cards.example: A **node** is a worker machine in a Kubernetes cluster.

cards.back: 主节点 - 运行控制平面的节点
cards.example: A **master node** runs the control plane components.

cards.back: 工作节点 - 运行应用容器的节点
cards.example: A **worker node** runs the application containers (Pods).

cards.back: 污点 - 排斥Pod的节点属性
cards.example: **Taints** repel Pods from nodes unless they tolerate the taint.

cards.back: 容忍 - 允许Pod调度到带污点的节点
cards.example: **Tolerations** allow Pods to be scheduled on nodes with matching taints.

cards.back: 节点亲和性 - 吸引Pod到特定节点
cards.example: **Node affinity** attracts Pods to specific nodes based on labels.

cards.back: Pod亲和性 - 将Pod放在一起调度
cards.example: **Pod affinity** schedules Pods near other specific Pods.

cards.back: Pod反亲和性 - 将Pod分散调度
cards.example: **Pod anti-affinity** spreads Pods across nodes for high availability.

cards.back: Pod拓扑分布约束 - 跨拓扑域分布Pod
cards.example: **Topology spread constraints** distribute Pods evenly across topology domains.

cards.back: 优先级类 - 定义Pod调度优先级
cards.example: A **PriorityClass** defines the scheduling priority of Pods.

cards.back: 抢占 - 驱逐低优先级Pod以调度高优先级Pod
cards.example: **Preemption** evicts lower-priority Pods to schedule higher-priority ones.

cards.back: Pod中断预算 - 限制同时中断的Pod数量
cards.example: A **PDB** limits the number of Pods that can be down simultaneously.

cards.back: 临时容器 - 用于调试的短期容器
cards.example: An **ephemeral container** runs temporarily for troubleshooting.

cards.back: 静态Pod - 由kubelet直接管理的Pod
cards.example: A **static pod** is managed directly by the kubelet on a node.

cards.back: 镜像Pod - API服务器中静态Pod的只读副本
cards.example: A **mirror pod** is a read-only representation of a static pod in the API.

cards.back: 运行时类 - 选择容器运行时的资源
cards.example: A **RuntimeClass** selects the container runtime configuration.

cards.back: 容器运行时接口 - Kubernetes和容器运行时的接口
cards.example: **CRI** is the interface between Kubernetes and container runtimes.

cards.back: containerd - 行业标准的容器运行时
cards.example: **containerd** is an industry-standard core container runtime.

cards.back: CRI-O - Kubernetes专用的容器运行时
cards.example: **CRI-O** is a lightweight container runtime specifically for Kubernetes.

cards.back: runc - 低级别容器运行时
cards.example: **runc** is a low-level CLI tool for spawning and running containers.

cards.back: gVisor - 用户空间内核的容器沙箱
cards.example: **gVisor** provides a sandboxed container runtime with a userspace kernel.

cards.back: Kata容器 - 使用轻量级VM的容器
cards.example: **Kata Containers** run containers in lightweight VMs for isolation.

cards.back: 监控 - 观察系统和应用状态
cards.example: **Monitoring** collects and analyzes metrics about system and application health.

cards.back: 可观测性 - 从外部输出理解系统状态
cards.example: **Observability** uses metrics, logs, and traces to understand system behavior.

cards.back: Prometheus - 开源监控和告警系统
cards.example: **Prometheus** is an open-source monitoring and alerting toolkit.

cards.back: Grafana - 开源数据可视化平台
cards.example: **Grafana** is an open-source platform for monitoring and observability.

cards.back: 指标 - 可测量的系统性能数值
cards.example: **Metrics** are numerical measurements of system performance over time.

cards.back: 计数器 - 单调递增的指标类型
cards.example: A **counter** is a cumulative metric that only increases.

cards.back: 仪表盘 - 可增减的指标类型
cards.example: A **gauge** is a metric that can go up or down.

cards.back: 直方图 - 样本分布的指标类型
cards.example: A **histogram** samples observations and counts them in buckets.

cards.back: 摘要 - 滑动时间窗口的指标类型
cards.example: A **summary** calculates streaming quantiles over a sliding time window.

cards.back: 日志 - 系统和应用事件的文本记录
cards.example: **Logs** are text records of events generated by systems and applications.

cards.back: 结构化日志 - 机器可解析的日志格式
cards.example: **Structured logging** outputs logs in machine-parseable formats like JSON.

cards.back: 日志聚合 - 集中收集和管理日志
cards.example: **Log aggregation** collects logs from multiple sources into a central system.

cards.back: ELK技术栈 - Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana
cards.example: The **ELK Stack** combines Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana for logging.

cards.back: Loki - Prometheus风格的日志聚合系统
cards.example: **Loki** is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available log aggregation system.

cards.back: Fluentd - 统一日志收集层
cards.example: **Fluentd** is a data collector for unified logging layers.

cards.back: Fluent Bit - 轻量级日志处理器和转发器
cards.example: **Fluent Bit** is a fast and lightweight log processor and forwarder.

cards.back: Jaeger - 分布式追踪系统
cards.example: **Jaeger** is an open-source distributed tracing system.

cards.back: Zipkin - 分布式追踪系统
cards.example: **Zipkin** is a distributed tracing system for microservices.

cards.back: 分布式追踪 - 追踪请求在多个服务间的流转
cards.example: **Distributed tracing** follows a request as it flows through microservices.

cards.back: 跨度 - 追踪中的单个操作单元
cards.example: A **span** represents a single operation within a distributed trace.

cards.back: 追踪 - 端到端的请求路径
cards.example: A **trace** represents the entire journey of a request through services.

cards.back: OpenTelemetry - 可观测性框架
cards.example: **OpenTelemetry** provides a unified standard for traces, metrics, and logs.

cards.back: 服务等级指标 - 衡量服务水平的具体指标
cards.example: An **SLI** is a quantitative measure of a service level.

cards.back: 服务等级目标 - 服务应达到的目标水平
cards.example: An **SLO** is a target value for an SLI over a period of time.

cards.back: 服务等级协议 - 服务提供方和用户的协议
cards.example: An **SLA** is a formal agreement about service levels between provider and customer.

cards.back: 错误预算 - 允许的停机时间或错误量
cards.example: An **error budget** quantifies the acceptable level of failure over a period.

cards.back: 琐事 - 手动重复性的运维工作
cards.example: **Toil** is manual, repetitive, automatable operational work.

cards.back: 站点可靠性工程 - 应用工程方法解决问题
cards.example: **SRE** applies software engineering to operations and infrastructure problems.

cards.back: 混沌工程 - 故意引入故障测试系统韧性
cards.example: **Chaos engineering** intentionally introduces failures to test system resilience.

cards.back: 混沌猴子 - 随机终止实例的工具
cards.example: **Chaos Monkey** randomly terminates instances to test fault tolerance.

cards.back: 演练日 - 模拟故障的应急演练
cards.example: A **game day** simulates failure scenarios to practice incident response.

cards.back: 事件管理 - 处理服务中断的流程
cards.example: **Incident management** is the process of handling service disruptions.

cards.back: 事后分析 - 事件后的回顾和总结
cards.example: A **post-mortem** analyzes the root causes and lessons of an incident.

cards.back: 无责备事后分析 - 关注系统性原因而非个人
cards.example: A **blameless post-mortem** focuses on system causes, not individual blame.

cards.back: 运维手册 - 处理常见运维任务的文档
cards.example: A **runbook** documents procedures for handling common operational tasks.

cards.back: 剧本 - 自动化运维任务的脚本集合
cards.example: A **playbook** is a collection of automated operational procedures.

cards.back: 蓝绿部署 - 两个环境切换的零停机部署
cards.example: **Blue-green deployment** switches instantly between two identical environments.

cards.back: 金丝雀部署 - 逐步推出新版本
cards.example: **Canary deployment** releases to a small subset before full rollout.

cards.back: 滚动部署 - 逐个替换实例
cards.example: **Rolling deployment** gradually replaces instances with the new version.

cards.back: 功能开关 - 运行时控制功能启用
cards.example: A **feature flag** toggles features on/off without deploying new code.

cards.back: 主干开发 - 频繁合并到主分支的开发模式
cards.example: **Trunk-based development** frequently merges small changes to the main branch.

cards.back: 功能分支 - 为特定功能创建的临时分支
cards.example: A **feature branch** isolates new feature development from the main codebase.

cards.back: 代码审查 - 检查代码质量的过程
cards.example: **Code review** improves code quality and shares knowledge among team members.

cards.back: 拉取请求 - 请求合并代码变更的提案
cards.example: A **pull request** proposes changes from one branch to another for review.

cards.back: 合并请求 - GitLab中的代码审查请求
cards.example: In GitLab, a **merge request** is the same as a pull request in GitHub.

cards.back: 代码审查清单 - 审查时检查的项目列表
cards.example: A **code review checklist** ensures consistent quality standards during review.

cards.back: 同行评审 - 同事间互相审查代码
cards.example: **Peer review** has colleagues examine each other's code for quality.

cards.back: 自审 - 提交前自己审查代码
cards.example: **Self-review** catches obvious issues before requesting peer review.

cards.back: 看起来不错 - Looks Good To Me的缩写
cards.example: **LGTM** means the reviewer approves the changes.

cards.back: 听起来不错 - Sounds Good To Me的缩写
cards.example: **SGTM** indicates agreement with the proposed approach.

cards.back: 请看一下 - Please Take A Look的缩写
cards.example: **PTAL** requests someone to review the code.

cards.back: 进行中 - Work In Progress的缩写
cards.example: **WIP** indicates a pull request is not ready for final review.

cards.back: 草稿拉取请求 - 尚未完成的PR
cards.example: A **Draft PR** is a pull request not yet ready for final review.

cards.back: PR描述 - 拉取请求的说明文档
cards.example: A good **PR description** explains what, why, and how of the changes.

cards.back: 提交信息 - 描述代码变更的日志
cards.example: A clear **commit message** describes what changed and why.

cards.back: 约定式提交 - 规范化的提交信息格式
cards.example: **Conventional commits** use a structured format for commit messages.

cards.back: 语义化版本 - 版本号传达变更含义
cards.example: **Semantic versioning** uses MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH to communicate change impact.

cards.back: Git - 分布式版本控制系统
cards.example: **Git** tracks code changes and enables collaboration among developers.

cards.back: 代码仓库 - 存储项目代码及版本历史的地方
cards.example: A **repository** stores code files and their version history.

cards.back: 克隆 - 复制远程仓库到本地
cards.example: **Clone** creates a local copy of a remote repository.

cards.back: 分叉 - 创建仓库的独立副本
cards.example: A **fork** creates an independent copy of a repository under your account.

cards.back: 分支 - 独立的代码开发线
cards.example: A **branch** is an independent line of development.

cards.back: 主分支 - 项目的默认稳定分支
cards.example: The **main branch** is the default stable branch of a repository.

cards.back: 主分支 - 传统的主分支名称
cards.example: **Master branch** is the traditional name for the main branch.

cards.back: 功能分支 - 开发新功能的分支
cards.example: A **feature branch** isolates new feature development from the main code.

cards.back: 发布分支 - 准备发布的代码分支
cards.example: A **release branch** prepares code for a new production release.

cards.back: 热修复分支 - 紧急修复生产问题的分支
cards.example: A **hotfix branch** quickly fixes critical production issues.

cards.back: 开发分支 - 集成开发中的代码
cards.example: The **develop branch** integrates ongoing development work.

cards.back: Git Flow - 一种分支管理模型
cards.example: **Git Flow** defines a strict branching model for project management.

cards.back: GitHub Flow - 简化的分支工作流
cards.example: **GitHub Flow** is a lightweight, branch-based workflow.

cards.back: 主干开发 - 频繁合并到主分支
cards.example: **Trunk-based development** frequently integrates code into the main branch.

cards.back: 合并 - 将一个分支的变更整合到另一个
cards.example: **Merge** combines changes from one branch into another.

cards.back: 变基 - 将提交应用到另一个基础提交
cards.example: **Rebase** moves commits to a new base commit for a linear history.

cards.back: 遴选 - 选择特定提交应用到当前分支
cards.example: **Cherry-pick** applies a specific commit from one branch to another.

cards.back: 压缩 - 将多个提交合并为一个
cards.example: **Squash** combines multiple commits into a single commit.

cards.back: 快进合并 - 目标分支无新提交时的合并
cards.example: A **fast-forward merge** moves the branch pointer forward without a merge commit.

cards.back: 三路合并 - 使用共同祖先的合并
cards.example: A **three-way merge** uses the common ancestor to resolve conflicts.

cards.back: 合并冲突 - 同一文件被不同方式修改
cards.example: A **merge conflict** occurs when the same file is modified differently in both branches.

cards.back: 解决冲突 - 手动合并冲突的代码
cards.example: **Resolve conflict** manually combines conflicting changes in a file.

cards.back: 暂存 - 临时保存未提交的更改
cards.example: **Stash** temporarily shelves changes to work on something else.

cards.back: 取消暂存 - 从暂存区移除文件
cards.example: **Unstage** removes files from the staging area.

cards.back: 暂存 - 将文件添加到暂存区
cards.example: **Stage** adds files to the staging area in preparation for commit.

cards.back: 暂存区 - 准备提交的更改区域
cards.example: The **staging area** holds changes ready to be committed.

cards.back: 工作目录 - 当前操作的文件目录
cards.example: The **working directory** contains the current files being worked on.

cards.back: HEAD - 当前分支的最新提交
cards.example: **HEAD** points to the latest commit on the current branch.

cards.back: 分离HEAD - HEAD不指向任何分支
cards.example: A **detached HEAD** means HEAD is not pointing to any branch.

cards.back: 标签 - 标记特定提交的引用
cards.example: A **tag** marks a specific commit as a milestone, like a release version.

cards.back: 附注标签 - 包含元数据的完整标签
cards.example: An **annotated tag** is a full Git object with metadata.

cards.back: 轻量标签 - 简单的提交引用
cards.example: A **lightweight tag** is a simple pointer to a commit.

cards.back: 签名标签 - 用GPG签名的标签
cards.example: A **signed tag** is cryptographically signed with GPG.

cards.back: 强制推送 - 用本地历史覆盖远程历史
cards.example: **Force push** overwrites remote history with local history.

cards.back: 推送 - 将本地提交上传到远程仓库
cards.example: **Push** uploads local commits to a remote repository.

cards.back: 拉取 - 从远程仓库获取并合并变更
cards.example: **Pull** fetches and merges changes from a remote repository.

cards.back: 获取 - 从远程下载变更但不合并
cards.example: **Fetch** downloads changes from remote without merging them.

cards.back: 上游 - 你fork或clone的原始仓库
cards.example: The **upstream** repository is the original source you forked from.

cards.back: 远程 - 默认的远程仓库名称
cards.example: **Origin** is the default name for your remote repository.

cards.back: 远程仓库 - 网络上的代码仓库副本
cards.example: A **remote** is a version of your repository hosted on the network.

cards.back: 子模块 - 在一个仓库中包含另一个仓库
cards.example: A **submodule** includes another Git repository within your repository.

cards.back: 子树 - 合并外部项目的方式
cards.example: **Subtree** merges an external project into a subdirectory.

cards.back: 单体仓库 - 包含多个项目的单一仓库
cards.example: A **monorepo** contains multiple projects in a single repository.

cards.back: 多仓库 - 每个项目独立的仓库
cards.example: A **polyrepo** uses separate repositories for each project.

cards.back: 二分查找 - 用二分法定位引入问题的提交

cards.back: 断连 - 下班后停止工作
cards.example: It's important to **unplug** after work hours when working from home.

cards.back: 数字游民 - 在旅行中远程工作的人
cards.example: As a **digital nomad**, she works from different countries each month.

cards.back: 联合办公空间 - 共享的办公环境
cards.example: I work from a **coworking space** twice a week for social interaction.

cards.back: 虚拟办公室 - 在线协作平台
cards.example: Our **virtual office** includes Slack, Zoom, and Notion.

cards.back: 视频会议 - 远程视频通话
cards.example: We use **video conferences** for team meetings and client calls.

cards.back: 屏幕共享 - 分享屏幕内容给他人
cards.example: **Screen sharing** helps debug issues and present work remotely.

cards.back: 虚拟背景 - 视频通话中的背景替换
cards.example: Use a **virtual background** to hide your home environment.

cards.back: 静音 - 关闭麦克风
cards.example: Please **mute** yourself when not speaking.

cards.back: 取消静音 - 打开麦克风
cards.example: Feel free to **unmute** and share your thoughts.

cards.back: 举手 - 请求发言
cards.example: Please use the **raise hand** feature if you want to speak.

cards.back: 分组讨论室 - 会议中的小组讨论空间
cards.example: We'll use **breakout rooms** for the team exercises.

cards.back: 录制 - 会议录像
cards.example: The meeting **recording** will be shared with those who couldn't attend.

cards.back: 文字记录 - 会议的文字转录
cards.example: The **transcript** is automatically generated from the meeting audio.

cards.back: 会议纪要 - 会议记录
cards.example: Please send the meeting **minutes** to all participants.

cards.back: 议程 - 会议讨论事项列表
cards.example: Please review the meeting **agenda** before the call.

cards.back: 主持 - 主持会议
cards.example: I'll **chair** tomorrow's architecture review meeting.

cards.back: 主持人 - 引导会议进行的人
cards.example: The **facilitator** ensures everyone has a chance to contribute.

cards.back: 记录员 - 记录会议内容的人
cards.example: Can someone volunteer to be the **scribe** for this session?

cards.back: 停车场 - 记录暂不讨论的话题
cards.example: Let's put that in the **parking lot** and discuss it offline.

cards.back: 离线讨论 - 会议外的单独沟通
cards.example: Let's have an **offline discussion** about this sensitive topic.

cards.back: 异步站会 - 不要求同时在线的每日更新
cards.example: We do an **async standup** in Slack instead of a meeting.

cards.back: 线程 - 消息应用中的对话分支
cards.example: Please reply in the **thread** to keep discussions organized.

cards.back: 私信 - Direct Message的缩写
cards.example: I'll send you the details in a **DM**.

cards.back: 频道 - 消息应用中的主题分组
cards.example: Each project has its own Slack **channel**.

cards.back: 提及 - 在消息中@某人
cards.example: **Mention** me in the channel if you need a quick response.

cards.back: 通知 - 提醒消息
cards.example: Turn off **notifications** during deep work sessions.

cards.back: 状态更新 - 关于工作进展的报告
cards.example: Please post your **status update** in the team channel.

cards.back: 周报 - 每周工作总结
cards.example: Submit your **weekly report** by Friday at 5 PM.

cards.back: 进度报告 - 项目进展的汇报
cards.example: The **progress report** shows we're 80% complete with the sprint.

cards.back: 摘要 - 内容的简要概述
cards.example: Here's a **summary** of the key decisions from the meeting.

cards.back: 回顾 - 简要回顾
cards.example: Let's do a quick **recap** of what we discussed.

cards.back: 后续步骤 - 接下来的行动计划
cards.example: The **next steps** are assigned to specific owners with deadlines.

cards.back: 要点 - 关键收获
cards.example: The main **takeaway** is that we need to redesign the API.

cards.back: 反馈 - 对工作的意见或建议
cards.example: I appreciate your **feedback** on the proposal.

cards.back: 意见 - 观点或建议
cards.example: We need your **input** on the technical approach.

cards.back: 共识 - 一致同意
cards.example: We reached **consensus** on using GraphQL for the API.

cards.back: 投票表决 - 请求投票
cards.example: I'll **call for votes** on the two proposed solutions.

cards.back: 待讨论项 - 暂时搁置的话题
cards.example: We'll address **parking lot items** in next week's meeting.

cards.back: 深度工作 - 专注无干扰的工作
cards.example: Block time for **deep work** to maximize productivity.

cards.back: 专注时间 - 不受打扰的工作时段
cards.example: I have **focus time** blocked on my calendar every morning.

cards.back: 时间块 - 为特定任务预留时间段
cards.example: **Time blocking** allocates specific time slots for different tasks.

cards.back: 番茄工作法 - 25分钟专注+5分钟休息
cards.example: The **Pomodoro technique** uses 25-minute focused work intervals.

cards.back: 上下文切换 - 在不同任务间切换
cards.example: **Context switching** between tasks reduces productivity.

cards.back: 多任务处理 - 同时处理多个任务
cards.example: **Multitasking** often reduces quality; focus on one thing at a time.

cards.back: 单任务处理 - 一次只做一件事
cards.example: **Single-tasking** improves quality and reduces mental fatigue.

cards.back: 批处理 - 集中处理同类任务
cards.example: **Batching** similar tasks together improves efficiency.

cards.back: 收件箱清零 - 处理完所有邮件的状态
cards.example: Strive for **inbox zero** by processing emails in batches.

cards.back: 暂停 - 延迟提醒
cards.example: I'll **snooze** this reminder until tomorrow morning.

cards.back: 提醒 - 提示做某事
cards.example: Set a **reminder** for the stand-up meeting.

cards.back: 日历块 - 在日历上预留时间
cards.example: I **calendar block** two hours daily for focused coding.

cards.back: 日程链接 - 允许他人预订时间的链接
cards.example: Send me your **scheduling link** and I'll book a slot.

cards.back: 可用时间 - 可以参加会议的时间段
cards.example: What's your **availability** for a sync this week?

cards.back: 冲突 - 时间上的重叠
cards.example: I have a **conflict** at 2 PM; can we meet at 3?

cards.back: 改期 - 重新安排时间
cards.example: We need to **reschedule** the meeting to next Tuesday.

cards.back: 取消 - 终止已安排的会议
cards.example: Due to the urgent bug, I need to **cancel** our 1:1.

cards.back: 拒绝 - 婉拒会议邀请
cards.example: I'll **decline** the meeting and catch up from the recording.

cards.back: 暂定 - 不确定是否能参加
cards.example: I accepted **tentatively** as I may have a conflict.

cards.back: 可选 - 不强制参加的会议
cards.example: Attendance for the demo is **optional**.

cards.back: 强制 - 必须参加的会议
cards.example: The all-hands meeting is **mandatory**.

cards.back: 回复全部 - 回复邮件所有收件人
cards.example: Please don't **reply all** unless everyone needs the information.

cards.back: 抄送 - Carbon Copy的缩写
cards.example: **CC** the project manager on this email.

cards.back: 密送 - Blind Carbon Copy的缩写
cards.example: Use **BCC** to protect recipients' email addresses.

cards.back: 转发 - 将邮件发送给其他人
cards.example: Please **forward** the client email to the team.

cards.back: 主题行 - 邮件的主题
cards.example: Use a clear **subject line** so recipients know the email's purpose.

cards.back: 签名 - 邮件末尾的署名
cards.example: Include your **signature** with contact details in work emails.

cards.back: 外出自动回复 - 休假时的自动邮件回复
cards.example: Set an **out of office reply** when you're on vacation.

cards.back: 升级 - 将问题上报
cards.example: This issue requires **escalation** to the engineering manager.

cards.back: 降级 - 降低问题的处理层级
cards.example: Successful **de-escalation** resolved the client complaint at the team level.

cards.back: 紧急 - 需要立即处理
cards.example: This is **urgent** as it affects production customers.

cards.back: 尽快 - As Soon As Possible
cards.example: Please handle this **ASAP**; it's blocking the release.

cards.back: 优先级 - 处理顺序的重要性
cards.example: What's the **priority** level of this task?

cards.back: 严重程度 - 问题的影响级别
cards.example: The bug's **severity** is critical as it causes data loss.

cards.back: 影响 - 对工作或系统的作用
cards.example: What's the **impact** of this delay on the release schedule?

cards.back: 缓解 - 减轻影响
cards.example: The **mitigation** plan includes a temporary workaround.

cards.back: 应急计划 - 备用方案
cards.example: We need a **contingency plan** if the migration fails.

cards.back: 风险评估 - 分析潜在风险
cards.example: The **risk assessment** identified three high-priority items.

cards.back: 利益相关者 - 受项目影响或影响项目的人
cards.example: Keep all **stakeholders** informed of schedule changes.

cards.back: 主题专家 - Subject Matter Expert的缩写
cards.example: Consult the **SME** on the database team for optimization advice.

cards.back: 概念验证 - Proof of Concept的缩写
cards.example: We need a **POC** before committing to the new technology.

cards.back: 试点 - 小规模试验
cards.example: We'll run a **pilot** with one team before company-wide rollout.

cards.back: 推出 - 逐步部署
cards.example: The **rollout** will happen in three phases over two months.

cards.back: 上线 - 系统正式运行
cards.example: The **go-live** date for the new platform is March 1st.

cards.back: 切换 - 从旧系统切换到新系统
cards.example: The **cutover** window is scheduled for Saturday 2 AM.

cards.back: 退役 - 逐步淘汰旧系统
cards.example: We'll **sunset** the legacy system by end of year.

cards.back: 生命周期结束 - End Of Life的缩写
cards.example: The third-party library reaches **EOL** next month.

cards.back: 弃用 - 标记功能将被移除
cards.example: The old API is under **deprecation** and will be removed in v3.0.

cards.back: 自我介绍 - 面试开始时的个人介绍
cards.example: Start your **self-introduction** with a brief background and relevant experience.

cards.back: 电梯演讲 - 30秒内的简短自我介绍
cards.example: Prepare an **elevator pitch** that summarizes your background in 30 seconds.

cards.back: 介绍你的简历 - 讲述你的工作经历
cards.example: '**Walk me through your resume**' is a common opening interview question.

cards.back: 优势 - 你擅长的领域
cards.example: My greatest **strength** is debugging complex distributed systems.

cards.back: 劣势 - 需要改进的方面
cards.example: My **weakness** is that I sometimes focus too much on code perfection.

cards.back: 职业目标 - 未来的职业规划
cards.example: My **career goal** is to become a staff engineer within five years.

cards.back: 成就 - 过去取得的重要成果
cards.example: My biggest **achievement** was reducing API latency by 80%.

cards.back: 挑战 - 遇到的困难
cards.example: Describe a **challenge** you faced and how you overcame it.

cards.back: 项目经验 - 参与过的项目
cards.example: Discuss your **project experience** with specific technical details.

cards.back: 技术深度 - 对技术的深入理解
cards.example: Demonstrate **technical depth** by explaining implementation details.

cards.back: 技术广度 - 了解多种技术
cards.example: Show **technical breadth** by discussing different technologies you've used.

cards.back: 问题解决 - 分析和解决问题的能力
cards.example: **Problem-solving** skills are essential for senior engineering roles.

cards.back: 系统设计 - 设计可扩展系统的能力
cards.example: **System design** interviews assess your ability to design scalable systems.

cards.back: 编程面试 - 考察编码能力的面试
cards.example: A **coding interview** evaluates your algorithm and coding skills.

cards.back: 行为面试 - 考察软技能和经验的面试
cards.example: **Behavioral interviews** use past experiences to predict future behavior.

cards.back: 白板面试 - 在白板上写代码的面试
cards.example: The **whiteboard interview** tests your ability to think and code on the spot.

cards.back: 带回家作业 - 面试前完成的编程任务
cards.example: The **take-home assignment** lets you demonstrate skills in a realistic setting.

cards.back: 现场编码 - 面试中实时写代码
cards.example: **Live coding** interviews assess how you think while writing code.

cards.back: 模拟面试 - 练习用的仿真题
cards.example: Schedule a **mock interview** with a friend to practice your answers.

cards.back: STAR方法 - 回答行为面试问题的框架
cards.example: Use the **STAR method**: Situation, Task, Action, Result for behavioral questions.

cards.back: 澄清问题 - 确认题目要求的提问
cards.example: Ask **clarifying questions** before jumping into the solution.

cards.back: 边界情况 - 不常见但需要处理的输入
cards.example: Consider **edge cases** like empty input, null values, and maximum limits.

cards.back: 时间复杂度 - 算法运行时间随输入增长的量级
cards.example: Always discuss **time complexity** when presenting your algorithm.

cards.back: 空间复杂度 - 算法使用内存随输入增长的量级
cards.example: Analyze the **space complexity** of your solution.

cards.back: 暴力解法 - 最直接但可能低效的方法
cards.example: Start with the **brute force** approach, then optimize.

cards.back: 优化 - 改进算法效率
cards.example: Discuss **optimization** opportunities after presenting a working solution.

cards.back: 权衡 - 不同方案之间的取舍
cards.example: Every design involves **trade-offs** between performance and maintainability.

cards.back: 瓶颈 - 限制系统性能的部分
cards.example: Identify the **bottleneck** in your system design.

cards.back: 可扩展性 - 系统处理增长负载的能力
cards.example: Discuss horizontal and vertical **scalability** in system design.

cards.back: 单点故障 - 系统中断的单一薄弱环节
cards.example: Eliminate **single points of failure** with redundancy.

cards.back: 缓存策略 - 提高读取性能的方法
cards.example: Describe your **caching strategy** for frequently accessed data.

cards.back: 数据库分片 - 水平分割数据库
cards.example: Explain **database sharding** for handling large-scale data.

cards.back: CAP定理 - 一致性、可用性、分区容忍度不可兼得
cards.example: The **CAP theorem** states you can guarantee at most two of C, A, and P.

cards.back: 负载均衡 - 将请求分发到多个服务器
cards.example: **Load balancing** distributes traffic across multiple servers.

cards.back: 限流 - 控制请求频率
cards.example: Implement **rate limiting** to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage.

cards.back: 微服务 - 小型独立部署的服务
cards.example: **Microservices** decompose applications into independently deployable services.

cards.back: API网关 - 统一API入口和管理
cards.example: An **API gateway** handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing.

cards.back: 消息队列 - 异步通信中间件
cards.example: Use a **message queue** for asynchronous processing between services.

cards.back: 事件驱动 - 基于事件触发的架构
cards.example: An **event-driven** architecture reacts to events rather than direct calls.

cards.back: 命令查询职责分离 - 读写分离架构
cards.example: **CQRS** separates read and write models for independent optimization.

cards.back: 事件溯源 - 用事件序列代替当前状态
cards.example: **Event sourcing** stores state changes as a sequence of events.

cards.back: Saga模式 - 分布式事务的一种实现
cards.example: The **Saga pattern** manages distributed transactions through compensating actions.

cards.back: 幂等性 - 多次执行结果相同
cards.example: **Idempotency** ensures repeated requests produce the same result.

cards.back: 分布式追踪 - 追踪请求在多个服务间的流转
cards.example: **Distributed tracing** follows a request through all microservices.

cards.back: 健康检查 - 验证服务是否正常
cards.example: Implement **health checks** for monitoring service status.

cards.back: 优雅降级 - 功能降级的服务继续方式
cards.example: **Graceful degradation** reduces functionality rather than failing completely.

cards.back: 断路器 - 防止级联故障的模式
cards.example: A **circuit breaker** prevents cascade failures in microservices.

cards.back: 舱壁模式 - 隔离故障的设计模式
cards.example: The **bulkhead pattern** isolates failures to prevent system-wide outage.

cards.back: 背压 - 控制数据流速的机制
cards.example: **Backpressure** prevents overwhelming downstream services.

cards.back: 死信队列 - 无法处理消息的特殊队列
cards.example: A **dead letter queue** stores messages that cannot be processed.

cards.back: 竞争消费者 - 多个消费者处理同一队列
cards.example: **Competing consumers** enable parallel processing of a message queue.

cards.back: 数据库索引 - 加速查询的数据结构
cards.example: Explain how you would use **database indexes** to optimize queries.

cards.back: 查询优化 - 改进查询性能
cards.example: Discuss **query optimization** techniques for slow database queries.

cards.back: 连接池 - 复用数据库连接
cards.example: Use a **connection pool** to efficiently manage database connections.

cards.back: 对象关系映射 - 简化数据库操作
cards.example: Discuss the pros and cons of using an **ORM** versus raw SQL.

cards.back: N+1问题 - ORM产生的性能问题
cards.example: The **N+1 problem** occurs when ORM makes excessive database queries.

cards.back: 对象存储 - 存储非结构化数据
cards.example: Use **object storage** like S3 for storing files and media.

cards.back: 内容分发网络 - 地理分布的缓存服务器
cards.example: A **CDN** caches content at edge locations for low latency.

cards.back: 域名系统 - 域名到IP的映射
cards.example: **DNS** translates domain names to IP addresses.

cards.back: 反向代理 - 代表服务器接收请求
cards.example: A **reverse proxy** sits in front of application servers.

cards.back: 服务网格 - 管理服务间通信
cards.example: A **service mesh** handles service-to-service communication.

cards.back: 边车模式 - 与主应用共存的辅助服务
cards.example: The **sidecar pattern** deploys helper services alongside the main application.

cards.back: 蓝绿部署 - 两个环境切换的部署策略
cards.example: **Blue-green deployment** enables zero-downtime releases.

cards.back: 金丝雀部署 - 逐步推出新版本
cards.example: **Canary deployment** releases to a small subset first.

cards.back: 功能开关 - 运行时控制功能启用
cards.example: Use **feature flags** to control feature rollout without deployment.

cards.back: 可观测性 - 通过输出来理解系统状态
cards.example: **Observability** uses metrics, logs, and traces to understand systems.

cards.back: 服务等级协议 - 服务提供方和用户的协议
cards.example: An **SLA** defines the expected availability and performance.

cards.back: 数据一致性 - 多副本间数据的一致性
cards.example: Discuss strategies for maintaining **data consistency** across services.

cards.back: 最终一致性 - 保证最终达到一致
cards.example: **Eventual consistency** is acceptable for many distributed systems.

cards.back: 强一致性 - 所有读取看到最新写入
cards.example: **Strong consistency** is required for financial transactions.

cards.back: 分布式锁 - 跨节点的互斥机制
cards.example: A **distributed lock** prevents race conditions across services.

cards.back: 领导者选举 - 分布式系统中选择主节点
cards.example: **Leader election** ensures only one node handles coordination.

cards.back: 一致性哈希 - 减少重新分配的哈希算法
cards.example: **Consistent hashing** minimizes remapping when nodes change.

cards.back: 虚拟节点 - 一致性哈希中的虚拟副本
cards.example: **Virtual nodes** improve load distribution in consistent hashing.

cards.back: 数据管道 - 数据从源头到目的地的流程
cards.example: Design a **data pipeline** for processing real-time analytics.

cards.back: 流处理 - 实时处理数据流
cards.example: **Stream processing** analyzes data in real-time as it arrives.

cards.back: 批处理 - 处理大量静态数据
cards.example: **Batch processing** handles large volumes of data periodically.

cards.back: 提取转换加载 - 数据集成过程
cards.example: **ETL** moves data between systems: Extract, Transform, Load.

cards.back: 数据仓库 - 结构化分析数据的集中存储
cards.example: A **data warehouse** stores structured data for analysis.

cards.back: 数据湖 - 原始格式存储大量数据
cards.example: A **data lake** stores raw data in its native format.

cards.back: 安全最佳实践 - 保护系统安全的推荐方法
cards.example: Follow **security best practices** for authentication and authorization.

cards.back: OWASP十大安全风险 - 最常见的Web应用安全风险
cards.example: The **OWASP Top 10** lists the most critical web application security risks.

cards.back: SQL注入 - 通过输入篡改数据库查询
cards.example: Prevent **SQL injection** using parameterized queries.

cards.back: 跨站脚本攻击 - 在网页中注入恶意脚本
cards.example: **XSS** (Cross-Site Scripting) injects malicious scripts into web pages.

cards.back: 跨站请求伪造 - 伪造用户请求
cards.example: **CSRF** tricks users into performing unintended actions.

cards.back: OAuth 2.0 - 授权框架
cards.example: **OAuth 2.0** enables delegated authorization for third-party applications.

cards.back: JSON Web Token - 紧凑的身份验证令牌
cards.example: **JWT** is used for stateless authentication between parties.

cards.back: 安全HTTP - HTTP over TLS
cards.example: Always use **HTTPS** to encrypt data in transit.

cards.back: TLS终止 - 解密TLS流量的过程
cards.example: **TLS termination** decrypts traffic at the load balancer.

cards.back: 零信任 - 不信任任何网络位置的安全模型
cards.example: **Zero trust** assumes no trust based on network location.

cards.back: 代码审查 - 检查代码质量的过程
cards.example: **Code review** catches bugs and shares knowledge across the team.

cards.back: 单元测试 - 测试单个组件的测试
cards.example: Write **unit tests** for critical business logic.

cards.back: 集成测试 - 测试多个组件协作
cards.example: **Integration testing** verifies components work together correctly.

cards.back: 端到端测试 - 模拟用户操作的完整流程测试
cards.example: **End-to-end testing** simulates real user scenarios.

cards.back: graph - 由节点和边组成的非线性数据结构
cards.example: A **graph** models networks, social connections, and dependencies.

cards.back: pointer - 存储内存地址的变量

cards.back: reference - 指向现有数据的别名

cards.back: memory leak - 不再使用的内存未被释放
cards.example: **Memory leaks** happen when allocated memory is never freed.

cards.back: garbage collection - 自动内存管理机制
cards.example: Go has a built-in **garbage collector**; Rust uses ownership instead.

cards.back: concurrency - 同时处理多个任务的能力
cards.example: Go's **concurrency** model with goroutines is powerful and efficient.

cards.back: parallelism - 真正同时执行多个任务
cards.example: **Parallelism** executes multiple tasks simultaneously on multiple CPU cores.

cards.back: thread - 操作系统调度的执行单元
cards.example: A **thread** is the smallest unit of execution the OS can schedule.

cards.back: coroutine - 轻量级的协作式多任务单元
cards.example: Go's goroutines are a type of lightweight **coroutine**.

cards.back: goroutine - Go语言的轻量级并发原语
cards.example: A **goroutine** is a lightweight, independently executing function in Go.

cards.back: channel - Go中协程间通信的管道
cards.example: A Go **channel** enables goroutines to communicate and synchronize.

cards.back: mutex - 防止多个线程同时访问共享资源
cards.example: Use a **mutex** to protect shared resources in concurrent programs.

cards.back: deadlock - 多个进程互相等待对方释放资源
cards.example: A **deadlock** occurs when processes block each other indefinitely.

cards.back: race condition - 执行顺序影响结果的不确定行为
cards.example: **Race conditions** happen when output depends on event timing.

cards.back: synchronization - 协调并发执行的机制
cards.example: **Synchronization** coordinates concurrent access to shared resources.

cards.back: atomic operation - 不可中断的单一操作
cards.example: **Atomic operations** are essential for lock-free concurrent programming.

cards.back: library - 可复用的代码集合
