cards.back: time complexity - 算法执行时间随输入增长的量级
cards.example: Analyze **time complexity** with Big-O notation to compare algorithm efficiency.

cards.back: space complexity - 算法占用内存随输入增长的量级
cards.example: **Space complexity** measures the memory an algorithm requires.

cards.back: Big-O notation - 描述算法复杂度的渐近表示法
cards.example: **Big-O notation** describes the upper bound of algorithm growth rate.

cards.back: Big-Theta - 紧确界的渐近表示
cards.example: **Big-Theta** describes both upper and lower bounds of growth.

cards.back: Big-Omega - 下界的渐近表示
cards.example: **Big-Omega** describes the lower bound of algorithm growth.

cards.back: amortized analysis - 平均操作成本的分析
cards.example: **Amortized analysis** gives average cost over a sequence of operations.

cards.back: worst case - 算法性能的最差场景
cards.example: The **worst case** is the maximum time or space an algorithm needs.

cards.back: best case - 算法性能的最佳场景
cards.example: The **best case** is the minimum time an algorithm requires.

cards.back: average case - 算法性能的平均场景
cards.example: The **average case** assumes random input distribution.

cards.back: bubble sort - 相邻元素比较的简单排序
cards.example: **Bubble sort** repeatedly swaps adjacent elements if they're in wrong order.

cards.back: selection sort - 每次选择最小元素的排序
cards.example: **Selection sort** finds the minimum element and places it at the beginning.

cards.back: insertion sort - 将元素插入到已排序序列
cards.example: **Insertion sort** builds the sorted array one element at a time.

cards.back: merge sort - 分治法排序算法
cards.example: **Merge sort** divides the array, sorts halves, and merges them. O(n log n).

cards.back: quick sort - 分治法高效排序
cards.example: **Quick sort** picks a pivot and partitions elements around it.

cards.back: heap sort - 利用堆数据结构的排序
cards.example: **Heap sort** uses a binary heap to sort elements in O(n log n) time.

cards.back: counting sort - 非比较线性时间排序
cards.example: **Counting sort** works on integers with O(n+k) time complexity.

cards.back: radix sort - 按位排序算法
cards.example: **Radix sort** processes digits from least significant to most.

cards.back: bucket sort - 将元素分布到桶中排序
cards.example: **Bucket sort** distributes elements into buckets, sorts each individually.

cards.back: tim sort - 混合稳定排序算法
cards.example: Python and Java use **Tim sort**, a hybrid of merge and insertion sort.

cards.back: stable sort - 相等元素保持原顺序的排序
cards.example: A **stable sort** preserves the relative order of equal elements.

cards.back: in-place sort - 不使用额外空间的排序
cards.example: An **in-place sort** uses O(1) additional space.

cards.back: comparison sort - 基于元素比较的排序
cards.example: **Comparison sorts** have a lower bound of Ω(n log n) time.

cards.back: linear search - 逐个检查元素的搜索
cards.example: **Linear search** checks each element sequentially. O(n) time.

cards.back: binary search - 对有序数组的高效搜索
cards.example: **Binary search** halves the search space each iteration. O(log n).

cards.back: ternary search - 将数组分成三份的搜索
cards.example: **Ternary search** divides the array into three parts for unimodal functions.

cards.back: interpolation search - 基于分布估计位置的搜索
cards.example: **Interpolation search** estimates position for uniformly distributed data.

cards.back: exponential search - 先找范围再二分搜索
cards.example: **Exponential search** finds a range then applies binary search.

cards.back: jump search - 固定步长跳跃后线性搜索
cards.example: **Jump search** jumps ahead by fixed steps then linear searches back.

cards.back: depth-first search - 先探索到底再回溯
cards.example: **DFS** explores as far as possible along each branch before backtracking.

cards.back: breadth-first search - 逐层探索的搜索
cards.example: **BFS** explores all neighbors at current depth before moving deeper.

cards.back: Dijkstra's algorithm - 单源最短路径算法
cards.example: **Dijkstra's algorithm** finds shortest paths from a source node.

cards.back: Bellman-Ford - 可处理负权边的最短路径
cards.example: **Bellman-Ford** handles negative weight edges unlike Dijkstra.

cards.back: Floyd-Warshall - 所有节点对最短路径
cards.example: **Floyd-Warshall** finds shortest paths between all pairs of vertices.

cards.back: A* search - 启发式最优路径搜索
cards.example: **A* search** uses heuristics to find the optimal path efficiently.

cards.back: minimum spanning tree - 连接所有顶点的最小权重树
cards.example: **MST** connects all vertices with minimum total edge weight.

cards.back: Prim's algorithm - 最小生成树算法
cards.example: **Prim's algorithm** grows the MST one vertex at a time.

cards.back: Kruskal's algorithm - 基于边的最小生成树算法
cards.example: **Kruskal's** sorts edges by weight and adds them if no cycle forms.

cards.back: topological sort - 有向无环图的线性排序
cards.example: **Topological sort** orders vertices so edges go from earlier to later.

cards.back: strongly connected components - 有向图中的最大强连通子图
cards.example: **SCCs** are maximal subgraphs where every node is reachable from every other.

cards.back: Tarjan's algorithm - 强连通分量算法
cards.example: **Tarjan's algorithm** finds SCCs using DFS with a single pass.

cards.back: Kosaraju's algorithm - 另一种强连通分量算法
cards.example: **Kosaraju's** uses two DFS passes to find strongly connected components.

cards.back: union-find - 管理不相交集合的数据结构
cards.example: **Union-find** efficiently manages and merges disjoint sets.

cards.back: disjoint set - 无交集的集合族
cards.example: A **disjoint set** data structure tracks partitioning of elements.

cards.back: path compression - 并查集优化技术
cards.example: **Path compression** flattens the union-find structure during find.

cards.back: union by rank - 并查集优化合并策略
cards.example: **Union by rank** attaches the shorter tree under the taller tree root.

cards.back: binary search tree - 有序二叉树数据结构
cards.example: A **BST** maintains order: left < parent < right.

cards.back: AVL tree - 自平衡二叉搜索树
cards.example: An **AVL tree** maintains balance factor of -1, 0, or 1 for all nodes.

cards.back: red-black tree - 近似平衡的二叉搜索树
cards.example: **Red-black trees** use color properties to maintain approximate balance.

cards.back: B-tree - 多路搜索树
cards.example: A **B-tree** generalizes BSTs to allow multiple keys per node.

cards.back: B+ tree - 用于数据库和文件系统的B树变体
cards.example: **B+ trees** store all data in leaves, used in databases.

cards.back: trie - 字符串高效存储和检索
cards.example: A **trie** stores strings for efficient prefix-based searches.

cards.back: segment tree - 区间查询的数据结构
cards.example: A **segment tree** answers range queries in O(log n) time.

cards.back: Fenwick tree - 高效前缀和数据结构
cards.example: A **Fenwick tree** (Binary Indexed Tree) computes prefix sums efficiently.

cards.back: binary indexed tree - 树状数组的另一种叫法
cards.example: **BIT** is another name for the Fenwick tree data structure.

cards.back: heap - 优先队列实现
cards.example: A **heap** (min/max) supports insert and extract-min/max in O(log n).

cards.back: priority queue - 按优先级出队的数据结构
cards.example: A **priority queue** dequeues the highest-priority element first.

cards.back: hash map - 键值对数据结构
cards.example: A **hash map** provides O(1) average-case lookup, insert, and delete.

cards.back: collision resolution - 哈希表处理碰撞的方法
cards.example: **Collision resolution** uses chaining or open addressing in hash tables.

cards.back: chaining - 哈希碰撞解决技术
cards.example: **Chaining** stores colliding elements in linked lists at each bucket.

cards.back: open addressing - 哈希碰撞解决技术
cards.example: **Open addressing** finds the next available slot for colliding keys.

cards.back: linear probing - 开放寻址的碰撞处理
cards.example: **Linear probing** checks consecutive slots for the next empty position.

cards.back: quadratic probing - 开放寻址的碰撞处理
cards.example: **Quadratic probing** uses quadratic increments to find empty slots.

cards.back: double hashing - 使用第二个哈希函数的探测
cards.example: **Double hashing** uses a secondary hash function for probe sequence.

cards.back: load factor - 哈希表中元素数量与容量比
cards.example: The **load factor** determines when to resize a hash table.

cards.back: rehashing - 增加容量后重新计算哈希值
cards.example: **Rehashing** redistributes elements when a hash table resizes.

cards.back: dynamic array - 可自动扩容的数组
cards.example: A **dynamic array** (like Go's slice) resizes automatically when full.

cards.back: amortized O(1) - 平均常数时间复杂度
cards.example: Dynamic array append is **amortized O(1)** despite occasional resizing.

cards.back: sliding window - 子数组/子字符串优化技术
cards.example: The **sliding window** technique optimizes substring/subarray problems.

cards.back: two pointers - 从两端向中间扫描的技术
cards.example: **Two pointers** traverse from both ends towards the center.

cards.back: fast and slow pointers - 检测循环的链表技术
cards.example: **Fast and slow pointers** detect cycles in linked lists.

cards.back: recursion tree - 可视化递归调用的树
cards.example: A **recursion tree** visualizes the branching of recursive calls.

cards.back: backtracking - 逐步构建解并回退的算法
cards.example: **Backtracking** builds solutions incrementally and abandons partial candidates.

cards.back: branch and bound - 优化回溯算法
cards.example: **Branch and bound** prunes branches that cannot contain the optimal solution.

cards.back: greedy algorithm - 每步选择局部最优的算法
cards.example: A **greedy algorithm** makes locally optimal choices at each step.

cards.back: dynamic programming - 分解子问题并存储结果的算法
cards.example: **DP** breaks problems into subproblems and stores intermediate results.

cards.back: memoization - 缓存子问题结果的技术
cards.example: **Memoization** stores function results to avoid redundant computation.

cards.back: tabulation - 自底向上的动态规划
cards.example: **Tabulation** fills a table iteratively from the bottom up.

cards.back: optimal substructure - 问题的最优解包含子问题最优解
cards.example: **Optimal substructure** means optimal solutions contain optimal subsolutions.

cards.back: overlapping subproblems - 子问题被多次计算的特性
cards.example: **Overlapping subproblems** are computed repeatedly in naive recursion.

cards.back: knapsack problem - 经典动态规划问题
cards.example: The **knapsack problem** selects items to maximize value within capacity.

cards.back: 0-1 knapsack - 物品不可分割的背包问题
cards.example: In **0-1 knapsack**, each item can be taken at most once.

cards.back: unbounded knapsack - 物品可无限选取的背包问题
cards.example: In **unbounded knapsack**, items can be selected unlimited times.

cards.back: longest common subsequence - 经典DP问题
cards.example: **LCS** finds the longest sequence present in both strings.

cards.back: longest increasing subsequence - 经典DP问题
cards.example: **LIS** finds the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

cards.back: edit distance - 两个字符串的最小操作数
cards.example: **Edit distance** (Levenshtein) measures string similarity.

cards.back: Levenshtein distance - 编辑距离的另一种叫法
cards.example: **Levenshtein distance** counts insertions, deletions, and substitutions.

cards.back: matrix chain multiplication - 最优括号化DP问题
cards.example: **Matrix chain multiplication** finds the most efficient multiplication order.

cards.back: coin change - 凑成目标金额的最少硬币数
cards.example: **Coin change** finds the minimum coins to make a target amount.

cards.back: house robber - 不相邻元素最大和问题
cards.example: **House robber** maximizes loot without robbing adjacent houses.

cards.back: climbing stairs - 到达第N阶的方法数
cards.example: **Climbing stairs** counts ways to reach step n using 1 or 2 steps.

cards.back: maximum subarray - 连续子数组的最大和
cards.example: **Maximum subarray** (Kadane's algorithm) finds the largest contiguous sum.

cards.back: Kadane's algorithm - 最大子数组算法
cards.example: **Kadane's algorithm** tracks maximum subarray ending at each position.

cards.back: two-sum problem - 找出和为目标值的两个数
cards.example: The **two-sum problem** finds two numbers that add up to a target.

cards.back: three-sum problem - 找出和为零的三个数
cards.example: The **three-sum problem** finds all unique triplets that sum to zero.

cards.back: four-sum problem - 找出和为目标值的四个数
cards.example: The **four-sum problem** extends three-sum to quadruplets.

cards.back: subarray sum - 和为特定值的子数组个数
cards.example: **Subarray sum equals k** counts subarrays with a given sum.

cards.front: 除自身以外数组的乘积
cards.back: product of array except self - 不使用除法的构造
cards.example: Compute the **product of array except self** without division.

cards.back: merge intervals - 重叠区间的合并
cards.example: **Merge intervals** combines overlapping intervals into disjoint ones.

cards.back: insert interval - 向区间集合中插入新区间
cards.example: **Insert interval** adds a new interval into a sorted non-overlapping set.

cards.back: non-overlapping intervals - 移除最小区间使不重叠
cards.example: **Non-overlapping intervals** removes the minimum to eliminate overlaps.

cards.back: meeting rooms - 判断是否需要额外会议室
cards.example: **Meeting rooms** determines if a person can attend all meetings.

cards.back: jump game - 能否到达最后一个位置
cards.example: **Jump game** determines if you can reach the last index.

cards.back: gas station - 环形路线起点选择
cards.example: **Gas station** finds the starting gas station's index for a complete circuit.

cards.back: candy distribution - 相邻评分更高的孩子获得更多糖果
cards.example: **Candy distribution** assigns minimum candies based on ratings.

cards.back: trapping rain water - 计算能接的雨水总量
cards.example: **Trapping rain water** calculates water trapped between elevations.

cards.back: container with most water - 双指针面积最大化
cards.example: **Container with most water** maximizes area between two lines.

cards.back: rainbow sort - 荷兰国旗问题的排序
cards.example: **Rainbow sort** (Dutch national flag) partitions into three groups.

cards.back: counting bits - 计算每个数的1的个数
cards.example: **Counting bits** computes the number of 1s in binary representation.

cards.back: single number - 找出唯一的非重复数
cards.example: **Single number** uses XOR to find the element that appears once.

cards.back: missing number - 找出0到n中缺失的数
cards.example: **Missing number** finds the missing integer in a sequence.

cards.back: bit manipulation - 使用位操作解决问题
cards.example: **Bit manipulation** uses AND, OR, XOR, shifts for efficient operations.

cards.back: XOR - 不同为1的位运算
cards.example: **XOR** returns 1 when bits differ, useful for finding unique elements.

cards.back: bitmask - 使用整数表示集合的技术
cards.example: A **bitmask** represents a set using individual bits of an integer.

cards.back: trie - 字符串高效存储
cards.example: A **trie** efficiently stores and retrieves strings by prefix.

cards.back: suffix tree - 存储所有后缀的树
cards.example: A **suffix tree** stores all suffixes of a string for pattern matching.

cards.back: suffix array - 排序后的后缀数组
cards.example: A **suffix array** stores lexicographically sorted suffixes.

cards.back: rolling hash - 高效计算子串哈希值
cards.example: **Rolling hash** (Rabin-Karp) computes substring hashes in O(1).

cards.back: Rabin-Karp - 基于哈希的字符串匹配
cards.example: **Rabin-Karp** uses rolling hash for multiple pattern matching.

cards.back: KMP algorithm - 线性时间字符串匹配
cards.example: The **KMP algorithm** achieves O(n+m) string matching.

cards.back: Z-algorithm - 线性时间字符串匹配
cards.example: The **Z-algorithm** computes Z-array for pattern matching in linear time.

cards.back: Manacher's algorithm - 最长回文子串算法
cards.example: **Manacher's algorithm** finds the longest palindromic substring.

cards.back: Palindrome - 正读反读相同的字符串
cards.example: A **palindrome** reads the same forwards and backwards.

cards.back: regular expression - 模式匹配语言
cards.example: **Regular expressions** define search patterns for string matching.

cards.back: finite automaton - 正则表达式的实现方式
cards.example: A **finite automaton** recognizes patterns in regular expressions.

cards.back: pushdown automaton - 上下文无关文法的实现
cards.example: A **pushdown automaton** extends FA with a stack for context-free languages.

cards.back: Turing machine - 计算理论模型
cards.example: A **Turing machine** is the foundational model of computation.

cards.back: P vs NP - 计算复杂性核心问题
cards.example: The **P vs NP** problem asks if every verifiable problem is quickly solvable.

cards.back: NP-complete - 最难的NP问题
cards.example: **NP-complete** problems are the hardest problems in NP.

cards.back: polynomial time - 高效可解的问题类别
cards.example: Problems solvable in **polynomial time** are considered tractable.

cards.back: exponential time - 随输入指数增长的时间
cards.example: **Exponential time** algorithms become infeasible for large inputs.

cards.back: factorial time - 比指数更慢的时间复杂度
cards.example: **Factorial time** O(n!) is worse than exponential time.

cards.back: cache eviction - 移除缓存中数据的政策
cards.example: **Cache eviction** policies include LRU, LFU, and FIFO.

cards.back: LRU cache - 最近最少使用淘汰策略
cards.example: An **LRU cache** evicts the least recently used item when full.

cards.back: LFU cache - 最不经常使用淘汰策略
cards.example: An **LFU cache** evicts the least frequently used item.

cards.back: cache hit - 请求数据在缓存中找到
cards.example: A **cache hit** occurs when requested data is found in the cache.

cards.back: cache miss - 请求数据不在缓存中
cards.example: A **cache miss** requires fetching data from the slower main store.

cards.back: spatial locality - 访问邻近数据的倾向
cards.example: **Spatial locality** means accessing data near recently accessed items.

cards.back: temporal locality - 重复访问相同数据的倾向
cards.example: **Temporal locality** means reusing recently accessed data.

cards.back: consistent hashing - 分布式系统中数据分片的算法
cards.example: **Consistent hashing** minimizes reorganization when nodes are added/removed.

cards.back: virtual node - 一致性哈希中的虚拟副本
cards.example: **Virtual nodes** improve load distribution in consistent hashing.

cards.back: rate limiting - 控制请求频率的机制
cards.example: **Rate limiting** prevents abuse and protects services from overload.

cards.back: token bucket - 限流算法
cards.example: The **token bucket** algorithm allows burst traffic up to a limit.

cards.back: leaky bucket - 平滑流量的限流算法
cards.example: The **leaky bucket** algorithm smooths traffic to a constant rate.

cards.back: sliding window log - 精确限流算法
cards.example: **Sliding window log** tracks exact request timestamps for rate limiting.

cards.back: sliding window counter - 近似限流算法
cards.example: **Sliding window counter** approximates rate limiting with less memory.

cards.back: circuit breaker - 防止级联故障的模式
cards.example: A **circuit breaker** stops requests to a failing service temporarily.

cards.back: bulkhead - 隔离故障的设计模式
cards.example: The **bulkhead** pattern isolates failures to prevent system-wide outage.

cards.back: throttle - 限制处理速度
cards.example: **Throttling** intentionally slows down processing to protect resources.

cards.back: debounce - 合并短时间内的多次触发
cards.example: **Debounce** combines multiple rapid triggers into a single action.

cards.back: deduplication - 消除重复数据
cards.example: **Deduplication** removes duplicate entries to save storage space.

cards.back: pagination - 将大数据集分成多页显示
cards.example: **Pagination** improves performance by loading data in chunks.

cards.back: cursor pagination - 使用游标的高效分页
cards.example: **Cursor pagination** uses a pointer for efficient deep pagination.

cards.back: offset pagination - 使用偏移量的传统分页
cards.example: **Offset pagination** uses skip/limit but is inefficient for deep pages.

cards.back: distributed ID - 全局唯一标识符生成
cards.example: **Distributed ID** generators like Snowflake create globally unique IDs.

cards.back: Snowflake - Twitter的分布式ID算法
cards.example: Twitter's **Snowflake** generates 64-bit unique IDs with timestamps.

cards.back: UUID - 全局唯一标识符
cards.example: A **UUID** is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information.

cards.back: Bloom filter - 概率型数据结构
cards.example: A **Bloom filter** tests set membership with possible false positives.

cards.back: Cuckoo filter - Bloom filter的替代
cards.example: A **Cuckoo filter** supports deletion with better performance than Bloom.

cards.back: Skip List - 概率性有序数据结构
cards.example: A **Skip list** provides O(log n) search with probabilistic balancing.

cards.back: LSM tree - 日志结构合并树
cards.example: An **LSM tree** (Log-Structured Merge) optimizes write-heavy workloads.

cards.back: MemTable - LSM树中的内存组件
cards.example: A **MemTable** is the in-memory component of an LSM tree.

cards.back: WAL - Write-Ahead Logging
cards.example: **WAL** ensures durability by writing changes to log before applying.

cards.back: Bitcask - 日志结构存储模型
cards.example: **Bitcask** is a log-structured key-value storage model.

cards.back: RUM conjecture - 读取-更新-内存的权衡
cards.example: The **RUM conjecture** states you can only optimize two of Read, Update, Memory.

cards.back: read repair - 副本不一致时修复
cards.example: **Read repair** fixes inconsistencies between replicas during reads.

cards.back: hinted handoff - 临时存储不可达节点的写操作
cards.example: **Hinted handoff** temporarily stores writes for unreachable nodes.

cards.back: anti-entropy - 副本间同步机制
cards.example: **Anti-entropy** mechanisms synchronize replicas to ensure consistency.

cards.back: Merkle tree - 高效数据一致性验证
cards.example: A **Merkle tree** efficiently verifies data consistency across nodes.

cards.back: vector clock - 分布式事件排序
cards.example: **Vector clocks** track event causality in distributed systems.

cards.back: logical clock - 分布式事件顺序
cards.example: A **logical clock** tracks event ordering without physical time.

cards.back: happens-before - 定义事件顺序的关系
cards.example: The **happens-before** relation determines event ordering.

cards.back: total order - 所有事件都可比较的顺序
cards.example: **Total order** means any two events can be compared.

cards.back: partial order - 部分事件可比较的顺序
cards.example: **Partial order** means some events may be incomparable.

cards.back: consensus - 分布式系统中达成一致
cards.example: **Consensus** algorithms ensure distributed nodes agree on a value.

cards.back: Byzantine fault - 任意行为的节点故障
cards.example: **Byzantine faults** occur when nodes behave arbitrarily maliciously.

cards.back: Byzantine Generals Problem - 分布式共识经典问题
cards.example: The **Byzantine Generals Problem** models achieving consensus with traitors.

cards.back: FLP impossibility - 异步系统共识不可能定理
cards.example: The **FLP impossibility** proves consensus is impossible in async systems with even 1 faulty process.

cards.back: CAP theorem - 一致性、可用性、分区容忍不可兼得
cards.example: The **CAP theorem** states you can only guarantee two of C, A, and P.

cards.back: PACELC theorem - CAP的扩展
cards.example: **PACELC** extends CAP: if partitioned, choose availability or consistency; else, choose latency or consistency.

cards.back: two-phase commit - 分布式事务协议
cards.example: **2PC** coordinates distributed transactions with prepare and commit phases.

cards.back: three-phase commit - 两阶段提交的改进
cards.example: **3PC** adds a pre-commit phase to reduce blocking in 2PC.

cards.back: Saga pattern - 长事务的补偿模式
cards.example: The **Saga pattern** manages long transactions through compensating actions.

cards.back: compensating transaction - Saga中撤销操作的事务
cards.example: A **compensating transaction** undoes the effect of a completed transaction.

cards.back: event sourcing - 用事件序列记录状态变化
cards.example: **Event sourcing** stores state changes as a sequence of events.

cards.back: CQRS - 读写分离架构
cards.example: **CQRS** separates read and write operations into different models.

cards.back: materialized view - 预计算的查询结果
cards.example: A **materialized view** is a precomputed snapshot of a query result.

cards.back: denormalization - 为提高读性能引入冗余
cards.example: **Denormalization** adds redundancy to improve read performance.

cards.back: sharding - 将数据水平分割到多个节点
cards.example: **Sharding** splits data horizontally across multiple nodes.

cards.back: range sharding - 按值范围分片
cards.example: **Range sharding** divides data by key ranges.

cards.back: hash sharding - 按哈希值分片
cards.example: **Hash sharding** distributes data evenly using a hash function.

cards.back: geo sharding - 按地理位置分片
cards.example: **Geo sharding** places data near the users who access it.

cards.back: hotspot - 访问高度集中的数据
cards.example: A **hotspot** occurs when a single shard receives disproportionate traffic.

cards.back: rebalancing - 数据在节点间重新分布
cards.example: **Rebalancing** redistributes data when nodes are added or removed.

cards.back: leader election - 选择主节点的过程
cards.example: **Leader election** chooses one node to coordinate in a distributed system.

cards.back: split-brain - 集群分裂成多个独立部分
cards.example: **Split-brain** occurs when a cluster divides into independent sub-clusters.

cards.back: quorum - 分布式决策所需的最少节点数
cards.example: A **quorum** is the minimum nodes required for distributed decisions.

cards.back: vectorized query - 批量处理数据的查询执行
cards.example: **Vectorized query** execution processes data in batches for efficiency.

cards.back: code generation - 查询执行的编译优化
cards.example: **Code generation** compiles queries to machine code for faster execution.

cards.back: predicate pushdown - 将过滤条件推到数据源
cards.example: **Predicate pushdown** applies filters at the data source to reduce I/O.

cards.back: partition pruning - 跳过不匹配查询的分区
cards.example: **Partition pruning** eliminates partitions that don't match query conditions.

cards.back: lazy evaluation - 需要时才计算结果
cards.example: **Lazy evaluation** delays computation until the result is actually needed.

cards.back: eager evaluation - 立即计算结果
cards.example: **Eager evaluation** computes results immediately when defined.

cards.back: tail recursion - 递归调用是最后操作的递归
cards.example: **Tail recursion** can be optimized to use constant stack space.

cards.back: tail call optimization - 复用栈帧的优化
cards.example: **TCO** replaces a tail call with a jump, saving stack space.

cards.back: coroutine - 可挂起和恢复执行的函数
cards.example: A **coroutine** can suspend execution and resume later, enabling cooperative multitasking.

cards.back: fiber - 用户级线程
cards.example: A **fiber** is a lightweight user-level thread managed by the runtime.

cards.back: green thread - 由运行时管理的线程
cards.example: **Green threads** are managed by the runtime, not the OS kernel.

cards.back: M:N threading - M个用户线程映射到N个内核线程
cards.example: **M:N threading** maps M user threads to N kernel threads.

cards.back: work stealing - 空闲线程从忙碌线程获取任务
cards.example: **Work stealing** improves load balancing in thread pools.

cards.back: NUMA - 多处理器内存架构
cards.example: **NUMA** means memory access time depends on the memory location relative to the CPU.

cards.back: false sharing - 不同CPU核心访问同一缓存行的不同变量
cards.example: **False sharing** causes cache invalidation when threads access different variables on the same cache line.

cards.back: cache line - CPU缓存的最小传输单位
cards.example: A **cache line** is typically 64 bytes, the smallest unit of cache transfer.

cards.back: cache coherence - 多核CPU缓存数据一致性
cards.example: **Cache coherence** ensures all CPU cores see consistent memory values.

cards.back: MESI protocol - 缓存一致性协议
cards.example: The **MESI protocol** manages cache line states: Modified, Exclusive, Shared, Invalid.

cards.back: memory barrier - 防止指令重排序的同步原语
cards.example: A **memory barrier** ensures memory operations are visible in the expected order.

cards.back: compare-and-swap - 原子条件更新操作
cards.example: **CAS** is the atomic operation: if value == expected, set to new; return success/failure.

cards.back: fetch-and-add - 原子加法操作
cards.example: **Fetch-and-add** atomically increments a value and returns the previous value.

cards.back: test-and-set - 原子布尔设置操作
cards.example: **Test-and-set** atomically sets a boolean and returns its previous value.

cards.back: spinlock - 忙等待的锁
cards.example: A **spinlock** busy-waits until the lock becomes available.

cards.back: semaphore - 限制并发访问数量的机制
cards.example: A **semaphore** controls access to a finite number of resources.

cards.back: counting semaphore - 允许多个访问的信号量
cards.example: A **counting semaphore** allows multiple concurrent accesses up to a limit.

cards.back: mutex - 一次只允许一个访问者的锁
cards.example: A **mutex** ensures mutual exclusion, allowing only one thread at a time.

cards.back: rwlock - 多读单写的锁
cards.example: An **RWLock** allows multiple readers or a single writer.

cards.back: condition variable - 线程等待特定条件的同步机制
cards.example: A **condition variable** allows threads to wait until a condition is signaled.

cards.back: monitor - 互斥锁和条件变量的组合
cards.example: A **monitor** combines a mutex with condition variables for synchronization.

cards.back: actor model - 通过消息传递并发的计算模型
cards.example: The **actor model** treats actors as concurrent entities that communicate via messages.

cards.back: CSP - 通过通道通信的并发模型
cards.example: **CSP** (Communicating Sequential Processes) uses channels for concurrency, like Go.

cards.back: STM - 事务性并发控制
cards.example: **Software Transactional Memory** provides atomic blocks for concurrency.

cards.back: lock-free - 不使用互斥锁的并发算法
cards.example: **Lock-free** algorithms guarantee at least one thread makes progress.

cards.back: wait-free - 每个线程都能在有限步骤内完成
cards.example: **Wait-free** is stronger than lock-free: every thread completes in finite steps.

cards.back: obstruction-free - 单个线程能独立完成
cards.example: **Obstruction-free** means a thread can complete if it runs alone without contention.

cards.back: ABA problem - 无锁算法中的状态回退问题
cards.example: The **ABA problem** occurs when a value changes from A to B back to A, fooling CAS.

cards.back: hazard pointer - 安全的内存回收机制
cards.example: **Hazard pointers** protect memory from being reclaimed while in use.

cards.back: epoch-based reclamation - 安全的内存释放机制
cards.example: **Epoch-based reclamation** safely deallocates memory in lock-free data structures.

cards.back: read-copy-update - 允许高效读操作的同步
cards.example: **RCU** allows extremely efficient reads with deferred updates.

cards.back: sequential consistency - 所有操作按程序顺序执行的内存模型
cards.example: **Sequential consistency** means operations appear to execute in program order.

cards.back: release-acquire - C++11/Rust的内存序
cards.example: **Release-acquire** ordering ensures writes before release are visible after acquire.

cards.back: relaxed ordering - 最弱的内存顺序保证
cards.example: **Relaxed ordering** provides no synchronization, only atomicity.

cards.back: happens-before relation - 定义内存可见性的偏序
cards.example: The **happens-before relation** defines which memory operations are visible.

cards.back: synchronizes-with - 线程间操作同步关系
cards.example: A **synchronizes-with** relationship ensures cross-thread visibility.

cards.back: program order - 单线程中的操作顺序
cards.example: **Program order** is the sequence of operations in a single thread.

cards.back: Application Programming Interface
cards.example: **API** stands for Application Programming Interface.

cards.back: REpresentational State Transfer
cards.example: **REST** stands for REpresentational State Transfer.

cards.back: Remote Procedure Call
cards.example: **RPC** stands for Remote Procedure Call.

cards.back: Software Development Kit
cards.example: **SDK** stands for Software Development Kit.

cards.back: Command Line Interface
cards.example: **CLI** stands for Command Line Interface.

cards.back: User Interface
cards.example: **UI** stands for User Interface.

cards.back: HyperText Transfer Protocol
cards.example: **HTTP** stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol.

cards.back: HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure
cards.example: **HTTPS** stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure.

cards.back: Transmission Control Protocol
cards.example: **TCP** stands for Transmission Control Protocol.

cards.back: User Datagram Protocol
cards.example: **UDP** stands for User Datagram Protocol.

cards.back: Internet Protocol
cards.example: **IP** stands for Internet Protocol.

cards.back: Domain Name System
cards.example: **DNS** stands for Domain Name System.

cards.back: Uniform Resource Locator
cards.example: **URL** stands for Uniform Resource Locator.

cards.back: JavaScript Object Notation
cards.example: **JSON** stands for JavaScript Object Notation.

cards.back: scalability - 系统处理增长负载的能力
cards.example: Horizontal **scalability** adds more machines; vertical adds power to existing ones.

cards.back: availability - 系统正常运行的时间比例
cards.example: Five nines **availability** (99.999%) allows only 5 minutes downtime per year.

cards.back: reliability - 系统持续正确运行的能力
cards.example: **Reliability** means the system operates correctly over time.

cards.back: fault tolerance - 系统面对故障继续运行的能力
cards.example: **Fault tolerance** allows a system to continue operating when components fail.

cards.back: high availability - 系统高度可用的架构设计
cards.example: **High availability** architectures eliminate single points of failure.

cards.back: load balancing - 将请求分发到多个服务器
cards.example: **Load balancing** distributes traffic across servers to prevent overload.

cards.back: round robin - 依次分配请求的负载均衡策略
cards.example: **Round robin** assigns requests to servers in sequential order.

cards.back: least connections - 分配给当前连接最少的服务器
cards.example: **Least connections** routes to the server with fewest active connections.

cards.back: IP hash - 基于客户端IP的负载均衡
cards.example: **IP hash** ensures a client always reaches the same backend server.

cards.back: weighted round robin - 根据权重分配的负载均衡
cards.example: **Weighted round robin** assigns proportionally based on server capacity.

cards.back: sticky session - 将用户请求固定到某服务器
cards.example: **Sticky sessions** route a user's requests to the same server.

cards.back: health check - 验证服务器是否正常运行的机制
cards.example: **Health checks** monitor server status and remove unhealthy instances.

cards.back: heartbeat - 定期发送的存活信号
cards.example: A **heartbeat** signal indicates a service is alive and responsive.

cards.back: graceful degradation - 功能降级的服务继续方式
cards.example: **Graceful degradation** reduces functionality rather than failing completely.

cards.back: failover - 主服务器故障时切换到备份
cards.example: **Failover** automatically switches to a standby server when primary fails.

cards.back: active-passive - 一个活跃一个备用的架构
cards.example: In **active-passive**, the standby takes over only when the active fails.

cards.back: active-active - 多个节点同时处理请求
cards.example: In **active-active**, all nodes handle requests simultaneously.

cards.back: single point of failure - 系统中断的单一薄弱环节
cards.example: Eliminate **single points of failure** by adding redundancy.

cards.back: redundancy - 额外的备份组件防止故障
cards.example: **Redundancy** adds duplicate components to prevent single points of failure.

cards.back: replication - 数据在多个位置之间同步
cards.example: **Replication** copies data across nodes for fault tolerance and performance.

cards.back: master-slave replication - 一主多从的数据复制
cards.example: **Master-slave replication** sends writes to master, reads can go to slaves.

cards.back: master-master replication - 多主可写的数据复制
cards.example: **Master-master replication** allows writes to any node, enabling high availability.

cards.back: multi-leader replication - 允许多节点写入的复制
cards.example: **Multi-leader replication** supports writes from multiple regions.

cards.back: leaderless replication - 任何节点都可写入的复制
cards.example: **Leaderless replication** (Dynamo-style) allows any node to accept writes.

cards.back: quorum read - 读取多个副本达到法定人数
cards.example: A **quorum read** contacts multiple replicas to ensure consistency.

cards.back: quorum write - 写入多个副本达到法定人数
cards.example: A **quorum write** requires acknowledgment from a majority of replicas.

cards.back: sloppy quorum - 临时写入可用节点的策略
cards.example: A **sloppy quorum** writes to temporarily available nodes during partitions.

cards.back: hinted handoff - 节点恢复后转发暂存数据
cards.example: **Hinted handoff** forwards temporarily stored data when a node recovers.

cards.back: read repair - 读取时发现不一致并修复
cards.example: **Read repair** fixes inconsistencies between replicas during read operations.

cards.back: anti-entropy repair - 后台同步不一致的副本
cards.example: **Anti-entropy repair** runs background processes to synchronize replicas.

cards.back: Merkle tree - 高效比较数据集的数据结构
cards.example: A **Merkle tree** efficiently compares datasets to find differences.

cards.back: consistent hashing - 减少重新分配的数据分片算法
cards.example: **Consistent hashing** minimizes remapping when servers are added/removed.

cards.back: virtual node - 一致性哈希中的虚拟副本
cards.example: **Virtual nodes** improve load distribution in consistent hashing.

cards.back: Rendezvous hashing - 另一种一致性哈希算法
cards.example: **Rendezvous hashing** (HRW) provides better load balancing.

cards.back: jump consistent hash - 几乎零内存的一致性哈希
cards.example: **Jump consistent hash** requires minimal memory and is fast.

cards.back: database sharding - 水平分割数据库
cards.example: **Database sharding** splits data across multiple database instances.

cards.back: application sharding - 在应用层实现数据分片
cards.example: **Application sharding** routes requests to the appropriate database shard.

cards.back: entity group - 需要放在一起的相关数据
cards.example: An **entity group** contains data that must stay together for consistency.

cards.back: hot partition - 接收不成比例访问的分区
cards.example: A **hot partition** receives much more traffic than others.

cards.back: partition key - 决定数据分布的键
cards.example: The **partition key** determines which shard stores the data.

cards.back: composite key - 由多个字段组成的键
cards.example: A **composite key** combines multiple fields to uniquely identify a record.

cards.back: surrogate key - 系统生成的唯一标识符
cards.example: A **surrogate key** is a system-generated unique identifier.

cards.back: natural key - 业务中有意义的唯一标识符
cards.example: A **natural key** has business meaning, like a social security number.

cards.back: foreign key - 引用其他表主键的字段
cards.example: A **foreign key** establishes a relationship between two tables.

cards.back: denormalization - 有意引入冗余提高读性能
cards.example: **Denormalization** duplicates data to reduce joins and improve read speed.

cards.back: materialized view - 预计算的查询结果存储
cards.example: A **materialized view** stores precomputed query results for fast reads.

cards.back: CQRS - 读写使用不同模型
cards.example: **CQRS** separates read and write models for independent optimization.

cards.back: event sourcing - 用事件序列代替当前状态
cards.example: **Event sourcing** stores state changes as a sequence of immutable events.

cards.back: snapshot - 某一时刻的系统状态副本
cards.example: A **snapshot** captures the system state at a specific point in time.

cards.back: command pattern - 将请求封装为对象
cards.example: The **command pattern** encapsulates requests as objects for queuing or logging.

cards.back: saga pattern - 长事务的补偿模式
cards.example: The **Saga pattern** breaks long transactions into compensatable steps.

cards.back: compensating transaction - 撤销已完成操作的事务
cards.example: A **compensating transaction** undoes the effect of a completed operation.

cards.back: orchestration - 集中协调Saga的执行
cards.example: **Orchestration** uses a central coordinator to manage saga steps.

cards.back: choreography - 各服务独立响应事件的协作
cards.example: **Choreography** has services independently react to events without a central coordinator.

cards.back: idempotency - 多次执行结果相同的特性
cards.example: **Idempotency** ensures repeated requests produce the same result.

cards.back: retry with backoff - 失败后延迟再重试
cards.example: **Retry with backoff** adds delays between retries to avoid overwhelming services.

cards.back: exponential backoff - 延迟时间指数增长的重试策略
cards.example: **Exponential backoff** doubles the wait time after each failure.

cards.back: jitter - 在重试间隔中添加随机性
cards.example: **Jitter** adds randomness to retry intervals to prevent thundering herd.

cards.back: dead letter queue - 无法处理消息的特殊队列
cards.example: A **dead letter queue** stores messages that cannot be processed successfully.

cards.back: message queue - 异步通信的中间件
cards.example: A **message queue** enables asynchronous communication between services.

cards.back: publish-subscribe - 消息广播模式
cards.example: In **publish-subscribe**, messages are broadcast to all interested subscribers.

cards.back: point-to-point - 消息一对一传递模式
cards.example: In **point-to-point**, each message is consumed by exactly one receiver.

cards.back: event bus - 集中分发事件的机制
cards.example: An **event bus** centralizes event distribution across services.

cards.back: event-driven architecture - 通过事件触发操作的架构
cards.example: **Event-driven architecture** reacts to events rather than direct calls.

cards.back: microservices - 小型独立部署的服务架构
cards.example: **Microservices** decompose applications into independently deployable services.

cards.back: service mesh - 管理服务间通信的基础设施层
cards.example: A **service mesh** manages service-to-service communication, like Istio.

cards.back: sidecar pattern - 与主应用共存的辅助服务
cards.example: The **sidecar pattern** deploys helper services alongside the main application.

cards.back: API gateway - 统一管理API请求的入口
cards.example: An **API gateway** routes, authenticates, and rate-limits API requests.

cards.back: backend for frontend - 专门适配前端的后端
cards.example: **BFF** provides tailored backends for different frontend requirements.

cards.back: strangler fig pattern - 逐步替换遗留系统的模式
cards.example: The **strangler fig pattern** incrementally replaces a legacy system.

cards.back: gateway aggregation - 在网关合并多个请求
cards.example: **Gateway aggregation** combines multiple requests into one at the API gateway.

cards.back: throttling - 限制请求速率
cards.example: **Throttling** limits the rate of requests to protect backend services.

cards.back: rate limiter - 控制请求频率的组件
cards.example: A **rate limiter** restricts how many requests a client can make.

cards.back: token bucket - 允许突发流量的限流算法
cards.example: A **token bucket** allows traffic bursts up to a maximum capacity.

cards.back: leaky bucket - 平滑流量的限流算法
cards.example: A **leaky bucket** smooths traffic to a constant output rate.

cards.back: fixed window - 简单计数限流算法
cards.example: **Fixed window** counts requests in fixed time intervals.

cards.back: sliding window - 更精确的限流算法
cards.example: **Sliding window** provides smoother rate limiting than fixed windows.

cards.back: distributed rate limiting - 跨多节点的限流
cards.example: **Distributed rate limiting** coordinates rate limits across multiple servers.

cards.back: caching - 临时存储数据以提高访问速度
cards.example: **Caching** stores copies of frequently accessed data for faster retrieval.

cards.back: cache eviction - 移除缓存中数据的策略
cards.example: **Cache eviction** removes old data when the cache is full.

cards.back: cache invalidation - 标记缓存数据已过期的机制
cards.example: **Cache invalidation** marks cached data as stale so it will be refreshed.

cards.back: TTL - 缓存或数据的过期时间
cards.example: **TTL** (Time To Live) specifies how long data remains valid.

cards.back: cache-aside - 应用负责维护缓存的模式
cards.example: In **cache-aside**, the application manages both cache and database.

cards.back: read-through - 缓存自动从数据库加载
cards.example: **Read-through** caches fetch data automatically from the database on miss.

cards.back: write-through - 同时写入缓存和数据库
cards.example: **Write-through** writes to both cache and database synchronously.

cards.back: write-behind - 异步写入数据库的缓存策略
cards.example: **Write-behind** (write-back) writes to cache first, then async to database.

cards.back: write-around - 绕过缓存直接写数据库
cards.example: **Write-around** writes directly to the database, bypassing the cache.

cards.back: cache stampede - 大量请求同时穿透缓存
cards.example: A **cache stampede** occurs when many requests hit a cache miss simultaneously.

cards.back: probabilistic early expiration - 防止缓存踩踏的技术
cards.example: **Probabilistic early expiration** refreshes cache before TTL to prevent stampedes.

cards.back: cache warming - 提前加载热点数据到缓存
cards.example: **Cache warming** loads frequently accessed data before it is requested.

cards.back: multilevel cache - 多层缓存架构
cards.example: A **multilevel cache** has L1, L2, and L3 layers with different speeds.

cards.back: CDN - 地理分布的缓存服务器
cards.example: A **CDN** caches content at edge locations near users for low latency.

cards.back: edge computing - 在靠近用户的位置处理数据
cards.example: **Edge computing** processes data near the source to reduce latency.

cards.back: origin server - CDN后端的真实服务器
cards.example: The **origin server** is the backend server behind a CDN.

cards.back: cache hit ratio - 请求命中缓存的比例
cards.example: A high **cache hit ratio** means most requests are served from cache.

cards.back: cold start - 资源首次初始化时的延迟
cards.example: A **cold start** occurs when a resource is initialized for the first time.

cards.back: warm start - 资源部分初始化后的启动
cards.example: A **warm start** reuses partially initialized resources for faster startup.

cards.back: database indexing - 加速数据查询的数据结构
cards.example: **Database indexing** creates data structures for faster query performance.

cards.back: B-tree index - 数据库常用索引类型
cards.example: A **B-tree index** is the most common database index type.

cards.back: LSM tree - 日志结构合并树
cards.example: An **LSM tree** optimizes write-heavy workloads like in Cassandra.

cards.back: inverted index - 从内容到位置的映射
cards.example: An **inverted index** maps content to its locations, used in search engines.

cards.back: bitmap index - 使用位图表示的索引
cards.example: A **bitmap index** uses bit arrays for efficient querying of low-cardinality data.

cards.back: hash index - 基于哈希表的索引
cards.example: A **hash index** uses a hash table for exact-match lookups.

cards.back: composite index - 多列组合索引
cards.example: A **composite index** spans multiple columns for multi-column queries.

cards.back: covering index - 包含查询所需所有列的索引
cards.example: A **covering index** includes all columns needed by a query.

cards.back: index-only scan - 从索引直接获取数据
cards.example: An **index-only scan** retrieves data directly from the index without table access.

cards.back: full-text search - 搜索文本内容的技术
cards.example: **Full-text search** indexes text content for efficient keyword searches.

cards.back: TF-IDF - 衡量词重要性的统计方法
cards.example: **TF-IDF** measures word importance in a document relative to a corpus.

cards.back: vector search - 基于相似度的语义搜索
cards.example: **Vector search** finds semantically similar content using embeddings.

cards.back: embedding - 表示语义的高维向量
cards.example: An **embedding** is a high-dimensional vector representing semantic meaning.

cards.back: cosine similarity - 衡量向量相似度的指标
cards.example: **Cosine similarity** measures the angle between two vectors.

cards.back: nearest neighbor search - 找到最接近的向量
cards.example: **Nearest neighbor search** finds the closest vectors in high-dimensional space.

cards.back: approximate nearest neighbor - 快速的近似向量搜索
cards.example: **ANN** trades perfect accuracy for significant speed improvements.

cards.back: HNSW - 近似最近邻算法
cards.example: **HNSW** is a graph-based algorithm for efficient approximate nearest neighbor search.

cards.back: IVF - 向量量化索引
cards.example: **IVF** (Inverted File Index) partitions vectors for faster search.

cards.back: product quantization - 压缩向量的技术
cards.example: **Product quantization** compresses high-dimensional vectors for efficient storage.

cards.back: data lake - 原始格式存储大量数据的存储库
cards.example: A **data lake** stores vast amounts of raw data in its native format.

cards.back: data warehouse - 结构化分析数据的集中存储
cards.example: A **data warehouse** stores structured data optimized for analysis.

cards.back: ETL - 数据集成过程
cards.example: **ETL** extracts, transforms, and loads data between systems.

cards.back: ELT - 现代数据集成方法
cards.example: **ELT** extracts, loads, then transforms, leveraging data warehouse power.

cards.back: change data capture - 追踪数据库变更的技术
cards.example: **CDC** captures database changes for replication or event streaming.

cards.back: outbox pattern - 可靠消息发布的模式
cards.example: The **outbox pattern** ensures reliable message publishing from transactions.

cards.back: inbox pattern - 幂等消息处理的模式
cards.example: The **inbox pattern** ensures exactly-once message processing.

cards.back: transactional outbox - 事务和消息的原子性
cards.example: **Transactional outbox** atomically saves data and sends messages.

cards.back: idempotent consumer - 安全处理重复消息的消费者
cards.example: An **idempotent consumer** handles duplicate messages safely.

cards.back: exactly-once semantics - 消息只处理一次的保证
cards.example: **Exactly-once semantics** ensures a message is processed exactly one time.

cards.back: at-least-once delivery - 消息可能重复但必达
cards.example: **At-least-once delivery** guarantees message delivery but may duplicate.

cards.back: at-most-once delivery - 消息可能丢失但不重复
cards.example: **At-most-once delivery** may lose messages but won't duplicate them.

cards.back: two-phase commit - 分布式事务协议
cards.example: **2PC** ensures atomicity across distributed systems with prepare and commit.

cards.back: three-phase commit - 改进的两阶段提交
cards.example: **3PC** reduces blocking by adding a pre-commit phase.

cards.back: TCC - Saga的一种实现
cards.example: **TCC** (Try-Confirm-Cancel) reserves resources before confirmation.

cards.front: 基本可用、软状态、最终一致性
cards.back: BASE - 替代ACID的模型
cards.example: **BASE** prioritizes availability over immediate consistency.

cards.back: soft state - 允许暂时不一致的状态
cards.example: **Soft state** allows temporary inconsistency before eventual consistency.

cards.back: eventual consistency - 保证最终达到一致
cards.example: **Eventual consistency** guarantees all replicas will converge over time.

cards.back: strong consistency - 所有读取看到最新写入
cards.example: **Strong consistency** ensures all reads see the most recent write.

cards.back: linearizability - 最强的一致性保证
cards.example: **Linearizability** is the strongest consistency model in distributed systems.

cards.back: serializability - 事务隔离的最高级别
cards.example: **Serializability** is the highest transaction isolation level.

cards.back: causal consistency - 因果相关操作有序的保证
cards.example: **Causal consistency** preserves ordering of causally related operations.

cards.back: session consistency - 同一会话内读写一致的保证
cards.example: **Session consistency** ensures read-your-writes within a session.

cards.back: bounded staleness - 读取数据不超过特定时间的旧
cards.example: **Bounded staleness** guarantees reads are no older than a specified time.

cards.back: monotonic reads - 后续读取不会看到更早的数据
cards.example: **Monotonic reads** ensure subsequent reads see equal or newer data.

cards.back: monotonic writes - 写入按发出的顺序应用
cards.example: **Monotonic writes** ensure writes are applied in the order they were issued.

cards.back: read-your-writes - 看到自己最新写入的一致性
cards.example: **Read-your-writes** ensures you always see your own most recent writes.

cards.back: write-follows-read - 写入传播到之前读取的副本
cards.example: **Write-follows-read** ensures writes propagate to replicas you've read from.

cards.back: PACELC theorem - CAP定理的扩展
cards.example: **PACELC** extends CAP with latency vs consistency tradeoff.

cards.back: lambda architecture - 批处理和流处理结合的架构
cards.example: **Lambda architecture** combines batch and stream processing for analytics.

cards.back: kappa architecture - 纯流处理的架构
cards.example: **Kappa architecture** uses only stream processing, simplifying the pipeline.

cards.back: streaming processing - 实时处理数据流
cards.example: **Streaming processing** analyzes data in real-time as it arrives.

cards.back: batch processing - 处理大量静态数据
cards.example: **Batch processing** handles large volumes of static data periodically.

cards.back: windowing - 流处理中划分时间窗口
cards.example: **Windowing** divides streams into time-based or count-based windows.

cards.back: tumbling window - 不重叠的固定时间窗口
cards.example: A **tumbling window** has fixed, non-overlapping time intervals.

cards.back: session window - 按活动间隙划分窗口
cards.example: A **session window** groups events by periods of activity.

cards.back: watermark - 流处理中处理延迟数据的机制
cards.example: A **watermark** indicates that all events up to a time have been observed.

cards.back: late data - 窗口关闭后到达的数据
cards.example: **Late data** arrives after its window has closed; watermarks handle it.

cards.back: exactly-once processing - 结果正确的流处理保证
cards.example: **Exactly-once processing** ensures correct results even with retries.

cards.back: idempotent sink - 保证重复写入安全的输出
cards.example: An **idempotent sink** safely handles duplicate writes.

cards.back: checkpoint - 流处理状态的快照
cards.example: A **checkpoint** saves the state of a stream processing job periodically.

cards.back: savepoint - 手动触发的状态快照
cards.example: A **savepoint** is a manually triggered, persistent checkpoint.

cards.back: state store - 流处理中保存中间状态
cards.example: A **state store** persists intermediate state in stream processing.

cards.back: changelog - 记录状态变化的日志
cards.example: A **changelog** captures state changes for replay or recovery.

cards.back: compaction - 合并和清理日志的过程
cards.example: **Compaction** merges log segments and removes obsolete records.

cards.back: log compaction - 只保留每个键最新值的压缩
cards.example: **Log compaction** retains only the most recent value for each key.

cards.back: schema evolution - 数据格式变更的兼容性处理
cards.example: **Schema evolution** handles changes to data formats over time.

cards.back: backward compatibility - 新版本能处理旧格式数据
cards.example: **Backward compatibility** means new code can read old data formats.

cards.back: forward compatibility - 旧版本能处理新格式数据
cards.example: **Forward compatibility** means old code can handle new data formats.

cards.back: zero-copy serialization - 无需解析直接访问数据
cards.example: **Zero-copy serialization** allows direct access without parsing overhead.

cards.back: data pipeline - 数据从源头到目的地的流程
cards.example: A **data pipeline** moves data from sources to destinations for processing.

cards.back: data ingestion - 将数据引入系统的过程
cards.example: **Data ingestion** brings data from external sources into your system.

cards.back: data processing - 将原始数据转换为有用信息
cards.example: **Data processing** transforms raw data into meaningful information.

cards.back: data transformation - 改变数据格式或结构
cards.example: **Data transformation** converts data from one format to another.

cards.back: data enrichment - 添加额外信息到数据集
cards.example: **Data enrichment** adds derived or external information to raw data.

cards.back: data validation - 确保数据质量和完整性
cards.example: **Data validation** checks that data meets quality and format requirements.

cards.back: data lineage - 追踪数据来源和转换
cards.example: **Data lineage** tracks the origin and transformations of data.

cards.back: data governance - 管理数据可用性、可用性和安全
cards.example: **Data governance** manages data availability, usability, and security.

cards.back: data quality - 数据的准确性、完整性和一致性
cards.example: **Data quality** measures accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.

cards.back: data catalog - 组织的数据资产清单
cards.example: A **data catalog** is an organized inventory of data assets.

cards.back: data mesh - 去中心化的数据架构
cards.example: **Data mesh** decentralizes data ownership to domain teams.

cards.back: data federation - 跨多个源统一查询数据
cards.example: **Data federation** provides a unified query interface across multiple sources.

cards.back: data virtualization - 无需移动的数据整合
cards.example: **Data virtualization** integrates data without physically moving it.

cards.back: data fabric - 统一的数据管理架构
cards.example: **Data fabric** provides unified data management across environments.

cards.back: zero-downtime deployment - 不中断服务的更新方式
cards.example: **Zero-downtime deployment** updates services without interrupting users.

cards.back: blue-green deployment - 两个环境切换的部署策略
cards.example: **Blue-green deployment** switches between two identical environments instantly.

cards.back: canary deployment - 逐步推出新版本
cards.example: **Canary deployment** rolls out updates to a small subset of users first.

cards.back: rolling deployment - 逐个替换实例
cards.example: **Rolling deployment** replaces instances one by one with new versions.

cards.back: feature toggle - 运行时控制功能启用
cards.example: A **feature toggle** enables or disables features without redeployment.

cards.back: dark launch - 在生产环境测试新功能
cards.example: A **dark launch** tests new features in production without user visibility.

cards.back: shadow traffic - 复制流量到新版服务
cards.example: **Shadow traffic** mirrors production traffic to a new service version.

cards.back: traffic splitting - 按比例分配请求
cards.example: **Traffic splitting** routes a percentage of traffic to different versions.

cards.back: A/B testing - 比较两个版本效果的方法
cards.example: **A/B testing** compares two versions to determine which performs better.

cards.back: chaos engineering - 故意引入故障测试韧性
cards.example: **Chaos engineering** injects failures to test system resilience.

cards.back: game day - 模拟故障的应急演练
cards.example: A **game day** simulates failures to practice incident response.

cards.back: fault injection - 故意引入错误测试恢复能力
cards.example: **Fault injection** deliberately introduces errors to test recovery.

cards.back: stress testing - 超出正常负载的测试
cards.example: **Stress testing** evaluates system behavior under extreme load conditions.

cards.back: load testing - 模拟高并发请求
cards.example: **Load testing** simulates high concurrency to find performance bottlenecks.

cards.back: soak testing - 长时间运行发现内存泄漏
cards.example: **Soak testing** runs systems for extended periods to find memory leaks.

cards.back: spike testing - 突然增加负载的测试
cards.example: **Spike testing** evaluates system response to sudden load increases.

cards.back: chaos monkey - 随机终止实例的工具
cards.example: **Chaos Monkey** randomly terminates production instances at Netflix.
